svg.title: Шраги с гирями — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing kettlebell shrug, straight-on front view. Two visible identical kettlebells, one rounded bell with loop handle in each hand at sides of thighs. LEFT relaxed shoulders down, both elbows straight. RIGHT raise BOTH shoulders clearly up toward ears, neck visibly shorter, elbows STILL straight and hands a little higher due only to shoulder lift. Athlete head remains level, feet and body height stay fixed. No elbow bends, no lifting arms sideways, no dumbbells. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
